The company builds digital tools for U.S. rental property owners and real estate investors, helping them collect payments from tenants, organize their books, and manage property banking in a single workspace. The goal is to make day-to-day finances easier to manage and give owners better information for running and growing their portfolios. The team brings experience in financial services and technology. You’ll report to the Head of Product and work with company leadership, Partnerships, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Compliance. The role involves two days a week in the downtown Toronto office. Work with Partnerships and external teams to assess opportunities, define what to build together, and decide which investments are worth making. Weigh customer value, acquisition cost, revenue potential, and delivery effort. • Build and launch integrated experiences. Lead discovery, design, and delivery with Engineering and Design. Coordinate requirements and launch decisions with the partner, then use real-world feedback to improve the experience. • Own performance across the funnel. Use SQL, cohort analysis, customer research, and experiments to improve the journey from the first encounter in a partner’s product through signup, identity verification, account funding, first meaningful use, and retention. • Make future launches easier. Identify what can be shared across integrations so future partners can launch faster and customers get a consistent experience. What You'll Bring • 4-6+ years in product management, with meaningful ownership of product growth, strategic partnerships, or distribution built into a product. • A record of taking a product from discovery through launch and improving it afterward, with measurable results in activation, conversion, engagement, retention, or revenue. • Fintech, banking, payments, property technology, or software built for a specific industry. • Embedded products, distribution partnerships, or marketplaces.
